entities.name: Manuel Arias y Porres
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Frey Manuel Arias y Porres was a Spanish Catholic prelate and statesman, Knight of the Order of Malta, Hieronymite monk, president of the Council of Castile during the reigns of Charles II and Philip V, Archbishop of Seville and Cardinal.
